notes.title: Two D&D Classics Are Back!
notes.notes:
Hello all D&D fans!

We’re excited to announce the re-release of two beloved classics - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843530/]Forgotten Realms: Demon Stone[/url] (2004) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843540/]Dungeons & Dragons: Dragonshard[/url] (2005), now updated for smooth play on modern PCs in 2025.

This is a faithful version of the original games with technical updates so they run smoothly in 2025. Just to clarify, these are not remasters; gameplay, balance, art, and story are unchanged. We’ve focused on compatibility and quality-of-life fixes.

Both titles have their respective changelogs available. If you encounter problems, please let us know in the Discussions (and include your OS, GPU/driver, and steps to reproduce).

Thanks for helping us keep these classics alive and have fun playing Demon Stone and Dragonshard!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843530/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843540/

notes.title: Silver Box, Spelljammer, DragonStrike, Fantasy Empires & DeathKeep are available
notes.notes:
Dear D&D community, 

We are happy to share that today we are bringing back eight long dormant Dungeons & Dragons games. The list features some of the first D&D video games adaptations, some available for the first time in over 25 years. Here's the list:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350550/Spelljammer_Pirates_of_Realmspace/]Spelljammer: Pirates of Realmspace [/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350530/Fantasy_Empires/]Fantasy Empires[/url], 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350520/DragonStrike/]DragonStrike[/url], 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350540/DeathKeep/]DeathKeep[/url], 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344020/Silver_Box_Classics/]Silver Box Classics[/url] (includes Heroes of the Lance, Dragons of Flame, War of the Lance, and Shadow Sorcerer). 

Spread the word and hope you'll enjoy diving into those worlds again. 

Thanks,
SNEG Team

notes.title: Quality of life update
notes.notes:
G​​old Box classics were always heavily relying on manuals, clue books, rule books and journals. Playing these games without them is close to impossible. Unfortunately, not all scans of the originals were in a quality we believe they should be. We kept on improving those, by going through each document one by one and re-scanning some of them (in case we have access to them), re-creating some of them from scratch to ensure they are easy to read, adding table of contents, etc. Hope you'll enjoy it. 

Please let us know if such changes are what helps you to get a better experience.

On top of it we've improved a few technical aspects: 
- added cloud saves
- updated GBC version
- fixed the option to make "Reset progress" while in the game
- showing exact error message in case game is not launching
- made UI improvements
- improved Gold Box launcher stability
- kept only those save slots visible that are in the folder during character import
- hid inactive dropdown options during character import


Thanks,
SNEG Team
